source.title: Call for Applicants - WAC Leader (May 2022)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new **WCA Advisory Council Leader**. The application is open to all WCA members. Potential applicants do not have to hold a current position to be considered.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the Council. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Good knowledge of the WCA structure
* A strong connection to the WCA Community

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until June 14th, 2022, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board (board@worldcubeassociation.org).

The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:

1. Brief personal introduction.
2. Summary of activities done for the WCA.
3. Ambitions as the WAC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WAC can be found in [WCA Motion 20.2021.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, as described in Section 4.2 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf).

Thanks for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 顾问委员会负责人招募（2022 年 5 月）
translation.content:
WCA 将任命新的**顾问委员会负责人**。所有 WCA 成员均可申请，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

候选人须能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周至少投入 5 小时处理委员会工作。我们希望候选人具备以下条件：

* 出色的领导能力。
* 出色的沟通能力。
* 熟悉 WCA 的组织架构。
* 与 WCA 社区保持密切联系。

申请时间为**即日起至 2022 年 6 月 14 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可将材料私下发送至 WCA 董事会（board@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：

1. 简短的个人介绍。
2. 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
3. 担任 WCA 顾问委员会负责人后的工作设想。

申请者还须提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WAC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 20.2021.1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/20.2021.1%20-%20Advisory%20Council.pdf)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将按照 [WCA 动议 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf)第 4.2 节的规定，通过投票选定并公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
